outcome: Medical intervention during labor (composite: cesarean delivery for FHR abnormalities and/or need for fetal scalp blood sampling for lactate measurement)
Suboptimal neonatal outcome (composite: 5-min Apgar score < 7, umbilical cord artery pH < 7.15, transfer to neonatal unit or perinatal death)
cohort: The study included all pregnant women at 41 weeks and beyond during one year in a single Maternity Unit.
finding: Umbilical artery resistance index and cerebro-placental ratio were strongly associated with the need for medical intervention during labor, but not with suboptimal neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: Abnormal fetal Dopplers at 41 weeks and beyond could identify situations at risk for medical intervention, including cesarean delivery for abnormal fetal heart rate, during labor.
cross-section timing: Doppler measurements were performed at 41 weeks gestation.
